To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
employee engagement is a role and multi-level construct that is influenced by different push and pull factors on the different levels and roles.
Employee engagement can be conceptualised and measured as a multi-level construct.
employee engagement is a multidimensional, multilevel construct that is affected by both push and pull factors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of whether employee engagement is a role related, multilevel construct.
the conceptualisation, measurement and confirmation of a multi level, multi role model of employee engagement.
the conceptualisation and measurement of employee engagement as a multi level construct, based on the multiple managerial roles that employees occupy in an organisation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
engagement is a multi role, multilevel construct.
employee engagement is a role related, multilevel construct.
employee engagement can indeed be viewed as a multilevel, multi-role construct, where significant spillovers and/or crossover effects are possible.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
employee engagement is not a mono level, mono-role construct, but a multi level, multi role construct where the different engagement factors are not necessarily correlated.
employee engagement can no longer be viewed as a mono level construct.
employee engagement should be conceptualised and measured on three levels, namely individual, team and organisation level.
The main takeaway from our work is that
employee engagement is not only a function of the individual but also of the team and management.
employee engagement is a complex multi level construct that can only be understood by looking at different roles and levels in organisations.
the engagement literature should be expanded to include different levels and roles in organisations to provide a more comprehensive picture of employee engagement.
